name: Entomology PhD
detailsNote: Program explicitly confirms Fall 2027 deadline. Current no-GRE and recommended courses supersede old 2019FAQ; advisor selection wording differs, so model omitted.

english.note: IELTS Academic no component below 6. Tests within two years before enrollment; unofficial for review, official after admission. Home Edition/IELTS Online accepted; no ITP+, MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Degree where English is exclusive instruction can exempt; foreign institution checked in WHED and extra proof may be required. TA requirements separate.

applicationFee.note: Central table explicitly covers Summer 2024–Spring 2027: international 155 USD/domestic 135; Fall 2027 fee not yet confirmed. Financial-hardship/preparation waivers limited to eligible US citizens/permanent residents/undocumented applicants, approved before payment, request at least 5 businessdays early.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from all colleges/universities for review; official records after acceptance
Graduate statement of purpose, maximum 2000 words: preparation, interests, UCR fit, motivation, goals/impact and community contribution
Three recommendation letters in English (two academic)
Foreign degrees: WES course-by-course ICAP evaluation after accepting offer; degree proof and certified English translations
requirements.note: Bachelor’s in entomology, biological science, chemistry, biochemistry or suitable equivalent; strength in life sciences. Master’s typical but direct bachelor-to-PhD possible. Science/math/data courses recommended, not required in current page, superseding older FAQ hard prerequisites. Identify faculty and research/teaching/outreach experience. Old FAQ requires potential-advisor commitment for admission; current page permits major-professor selection by first-quarter end; confirm route, model omitted.

funding.note: Competitive fellowships/traineeships can waive nonresident tuition, explicitly valuable to internationals. All applicants automatically considered, support offers with admission; no guarantee. Late/non-fall support only if available. GAANN restricted to US citizens/permanent residents and financial need.

publishedDeadlines.note: Annual early-completion recommendation; earlier than current final deadline.
